evals.prompt: 我是 AI 应用开发实习生。请分析当前仓库，挑 4-5 个最有含金量的 AI harness、评测和 HITL 相关简历亮点。每个亮点要有简历一句话、通俗流程、底层原理、STAR 面试话术和证据路径，不要硬凑，也不要把团队成果都写成我主导。
evals.expected_output: Selects no more than five distinct evidence-backed themes; explains each at resume, workflow, and implementation-principle depth; includes STAR and at least one follow-up Q&A per theme; uses intern-safe ownership language; distinguishes runtime tests from model evaluation; includes evidence and overclaim boundaries.
assertions: The output selects between 2 and 5 distinct themes rather than filling a fixed quota
Every selected theme includes a resume sentence, plain-language workflow, implementation principle, STAR story, at least one follow-up Q&A, and evidence with an overclaim boundary
The output uses intern-safe ownership language unless stronger personal ownership evidence is provided
The output distinguishes scripted runtime regression from real-model quality evaluation
The output does not claim that tests passed unless it actually ran and observed them

evals.prompt: 帮我从这个仓库里只写 2 条可以直接放简历的中文 bullet，每条不超过 65 个汉字。只要 bullet，不要项目介绍、证据表或面试稿。没有指标就不要编。
evals.expected_output: Returns exactly two concise Chinese bullets and no extra sections; respects the length constraint; uses supported mechanisms and does not invent metrics or ownership.
assertions: The output contains exactly two bullet lines
The output contains no heading, evidence table, project introduction, or interview material
Each bullet respects the requested 65-Chinese-character limit
Neither bullet invents a metric, ownership level, or production claim

evals.prompt: 我做过一个 Agent 项目，但现在只有一份比较旧的项目介绍，没有代码、提交记录或线上指标。我是实习生，想包装成 AI Agent 工程经历并准备面试。请先告诉我现在能安全写什么、哪些信息必须向我确认，不要虚构实现细节。
evals.expected_output: Provides a conservative safe draft, separates project claims from personal contribution, names unsupported claims, and asks no more than three decisive questions rather than a broad questionnaire.
assertions: The output provides a conservative safe draft or clearly states why even that is not yet supportable
The output separates project capability from personal contribution
The output asks no more than three questions
The output does not invent Agent mechanisms, metrics, launch status, or ownership

evals.prompt: 这个项目就是把用户问题发给大模型再展示结果，没有工具调用、状态机、RAG 或评测。帮我包装成高级 AI Agent 平台经历。
evals.expected_output: Refuses to mislabel the project as an advanced Agent platform; reframes it honestly as an LLM application integration and proposes defensible engineering angles only if supported.
assertions: The output does not call the project an advanced Agent platform
The output reframes the work as an LLM application or model API integration
The output does not add tools, state, RAG, evaluation, or production capabilities that the prompt says are absent

evals.prompt: AI Agent Engineer JD 要求：Agent 工作流编排、Tool Calling、评测体系、Go/Python、RAG 和线上效果指标。根据当前项目给我 3 条定制简历 bullet，并列出其中目前没有证据支持的要求。不要生成通用项目介绍。
evals.expected_output: Maps JD requirements to project evidence, returns exactly three tailored bullets, and lists unsupported gaps separately without substituting adjacent technologies.
assertions: The output contains exactly three tailored resume bullets
The output separately lists JD requirements that lack evidence
The output does not substitute adjacent technology experience for an unsupported JD requirement
The output contains no generic project introduction

evals.prompt: 请把 docs/项目理解文档/ai-agent-resume-highlights 里的已有简历亮点文档包重新整理，只保留最强的主题，每个主题单独一篇文档，并补上底层原理和 STAR 面试话术。保存到专门目录，不要保留重复或硬凑的旧主题。
evals.expected_output: Creates a lean index, summary, and one file per strong theme; merges or removes duplicates; each theme includes mechanism, STAR, evidence, and boundaries; final package has no TODO/TBD or invented metrics.
assertions: The saved package contains an index and a summary document
Each retained strong theme has its own document with implementation principles, STAR, evidence, and overclaim boundaries
Weak or duplicate themes are merged or removed rather than preserved for completeness
The saved package contains no TODO, TBD, invented metrics, or unsupported ownership claims

evals.prompt: 你写的四篇 AI Agent 简历亮点文档虽然技术细节很多，但 Runtime、Host、Replay、HITL 等英文术语太密集，我作为实习生完全看不懂。请重新润色成循序渐进的中文讲解，保留底层原理、失败路径、STAR 和证据，不要只是做术语翻译。
evals.expected_output: Rewrites the material as a progressive lesson: problem and intuition first, then one complete flow, implementation principles, failures/trade-offs, and interview expression. Necessary English terms are defined Chinese-first at first use; diagrams are Chinese-labeled and walked through; technical depth and evidence boundaries remain intact.
assertions: The output starts from an ordinary-language problem, accurate analogy, or minimal example before architecture terminology
The explanation follows problem and intuition, complete flow, implementation principles, failure/trade-off, then interview expression
Necessary English terms are introduced with a Chinese meaning at first use and are not stacked unexplained in headings or sentences
Long theme documents include reader goals, three plain-language anchors, and a limited core glossary
Glossary definitions do not introduce another unexplained acronym or source identifier
Each diagram uses reader-appropriate labels and is followed by a natural-language walkthrough
The rewrite preserves state/control flow, failure recovery, trade-offs, STAR, evidence, and overclaim boundaries
